dedupe_keys.name: meteor nepal landslide hazard maps rainfall triggered and seismic triggered

description: These two national raster maps give the rainfall-triggered and the seismic-triggered landslide hazard of Nepal at 90 m resolution in the UTM zone 45N projection, generated in 2020. They were produced by Claire Dashwood, Roxana Ciurean and Kay Smith of the British Geological Survey in METEOR (Modelling Exposure Through Earth Observation Routines: EO-based Exposure, Nepal and Tanzania), a 2.8 million pound project co-funded by the UK Space Agency International Partnership Programme under the Global Challenges Research Fund, with methods set out in the 2020 BGS METEOR landslide hazard report. Both maps were deposited on Zenodo in March 2026 as free zip files (58 MB for the rainfall map and 135 MB for the seismic map) under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the methodology report is listed as unpublished on NORA, the maps show susceptibility-based hazard classes, not event probabilities, and they reflect 2020 inputs. They support hazard exposure analysis of roads, hydropower, transmission lines and settlements in Nepal and scenario design for multi-hazard infrastructure risk; related records are the GEM Global Seismic Hazard Map and ThinkHazard.
